name: exact_dual
source: private theorem exact_dual (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℤ_[l] N]
Function.Exact (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) p.mkQ) (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) p.subtype) := by
have h := (dualKer l N (N ⧸ p) p.mkQ).1
generalize LinearMap.ker p.mkQ = q at h hq
show: For any submodule P of a ℤℓ-module N, the dual maps from (N/P)* to N* and from N* to P* are exact at N*, with dual taken into ℚℓ/ℤℓ and maps induced by quotient and inclusion.
strategy: Identify the image of the dual quotient map with the functionals vanishing on the kernel of the quotient.

steps.claim: Let π be the quotient N → N/P and res the restriction of characters to P. The image of pullback π* consists of the characters vanishing on ker π. Since ker π = P, this is exactly ker(res), proving exactness of D(N/P) → D(N) → D(P) at D(N), with D(A) = Homℤℓ(A,ℚℓ/ℤℓ).
steps.snippet:
Function.Exact (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) p.mkQ) (LinearMap.lcomp ℤ_[l] (QZ l) p.subtype) := by
  rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]
  have h := (dualKer l N (N ⧸ p) p.mkQ).1
  have hq := Submodule.ker_mkQ p
  generalize LinearMap.ker p.mkQ = q at h hq
  subst hq
  exact h.symm
